description: Prompt-injection scanner for AI agents — Scan untrusted content BEFORE your agent reads it (web pages, emails, documents, tool outputs, user messages). Offline, deterministic, ~ms: detects instruction overrides (ignore previous instructions...), jailbreak/persona swaps, system-prompt extraction, text addressed to AI readers, fake authority/urgency, requests to send secrets or move money, run-this-command tool abuse, markdown/HTML image exfiltration links, fake chat-template turns (ChatML, Llama [INST], Harmony, Human:/Assistant:), invisible Unicode TAG smuggling (decoded and rescanned), zero-width and bidi tricks, instructions hidden in HTML comments or CSS, base64 and spaced/leetspeak obfuscation. Returns verdict CLEAN / LOW_RISK / SUSPICIOUS / INJECTION_LIKELY, risk_score 0-100, findings with severity and excerpt, hidden-content stats, and a recommended action. Pass text= (max 20,000 chars); optional source=web|email|document|tool|user, sanitize=true (returns text with invisible chars, HTML comments and chat-template tokens removed). Heuristic: text that discusses prompt injection can match too. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
